data.name: Cyril
data.gender_notes: Cyril is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Cyril is recorded in name-lists as “Rule of the Lord”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Cyril expresses “Rule of the Lord”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cyril total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
